component.name: HydroLink
component.summary: Watch companion server and plugin platform
手表互联服务端与插件平台

description.p: HydroLink is the desktop side of a watch + desktop setup: it serves the HTTP API the watch app talks to (pairing, device status, music, commands, plugins) and hosts the HydroKit plugin platform, so installed plugins can render their own interfaces on the watch and expose a settings UI on the desktop.
HydroLink 是「手表 + 桌面」方案中的桌面端：为手表 App 提供 HTTP 接口（配对、设备状态、 音乐、命令、插件），并承载 HydroKit 插件平台 —— 插件可在手表上渲染自己的界面， 同时在桌面端提供设置界面。
